title: Ethiopian Ayib with Herbs
community: All of Ethiopia — the herb-enriched fresh cheese
author: Mama Tigist
desc: Ethiopian Ayib with Herbs — freshly made ayib (ETH096) mixed with finely chopped green jalapeño, coriander, and spring onion. The herb-enriched version of the essential Ethiopian fresh cheese — more complex than plain ayib, this version serves as both a condiment and a standalone dip.
longDesc: Ayib with herbs takes the plain fresh cheese of ETH096 and elevates it into a condiment of its own character — the green jalapeño provides mild heat, the coriander adds freshness, and the spring onion adds sharpness. Served in a larger mound on the celebration platter.
ingredients: ¼ cup fresh coriander — finely chopped
steps: Drain for 1.5 hours until firm but still moist.
Add finely diced jalapeño, coriander, spring onion, and lemon zest.
Mix gently — do not over-mix or the texture becomes paste-like.
Shape into a mound or serve in a ramekin.
chefTips: Mix gently — ayib should stay crumbly, not become a paste.
The green jalapeño is milder than berbere — this is intentionally mild heat.
Lemon zest brightens the herb flavours.
Serve at room temperature — cold ayib loses its flavour.
cookingScience: See ETH096 for cheese-making science. The addition of jalapeño (capsaicin dissolved in the cheese fat) creates a mild heat that persists longer than water-soluble capsaicin sources — the fat slows the release of capsaicin onto capsaicin receptors.
sustainabilityTips: Fresh cheese made and consumed same day — zero-waste dairy use.
servedWith: As a standalone dip with injera
healthBenefits: Fresh herbs add vitamins A and C.
Probiotic from the lactic acid in fresh cheese.
culturalNote: Ayib with herbs is the celebration version of the essential cheese — the additional herbs signal that this is a special occasion, that the cook has taken extra care, that the guest deserves more than the plain version.
